qualityNotes.schemaConformance: All 8 trails conform to Frames.cs + TrailStore.cs schema (PlannerFrame, MakerFrame, CheckerFrame, ReflectorFrame, SealedCycle, Baton, EarnedConstraint, GroundTruth). PascalCase field names per .NET System.Text.Json convention.
qualityNotes.voiceConformance: All frames use 'I am the [Role], cycle N' first-person opening per agent definition files. Planner stays at cognitive layer (EC-001). Maker surfaces gaps mid-output. Checker uses VERIFIED/SYNTHESIZED/UNVERIFIED/CONTRADICTED per-claim labels. Reflector uses five-part constraint format law when earning.
qualityNotes.dispositionVariety: 6 Accept, 1 Retry (with NEEDS-REVISION), 1 inherited Halt (from existing meta-architecture trail). Retry cycle demonstrates the loop correctly seeding the error as the next intent.
qualityNotes.earnedConstraintVariety: 2 cycles crystallize earned constraints: td-004 triggers EC-001 recurrence (OccurrenceCount 2, O-Mode switch recommended); td-005 earns a new EC-004 (OccurrenceCount 3, Write Verification Law). Remaining cycles explicitly decline to fabricate unearned constraints.
qualityNotes.groundTruthPattern: All 8 Maker frames carry a GroundTruth record with VerificationMethod, Verified, and Evidence fields. SYNTHESIZED inferences are labeled in both Maker and Checker frames rather than carrying VERIFIED confidence.
qualityNotes.ec002Compliance: All 8 cycles apply EC-002: every Checker frame notes that Reflector is one recursive layer higher due to full first-person frame chain, and every Reflector frame acknowledges this structural property explicitly.
